title: clematis aristata var. coriacea
intro: Clematis aristata var. coriacea, commonly known as Mountain Clematis, is a type of flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of North America. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Clematis include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe various health issues, including menstrual cramps and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Clematis include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
